question.text: Under SEBI AIF Regulations (Regulation 16 and 17), Cat I and Cat II AIFs:

answer.text: Must invest only in listed equity.

May NOT borrow funds for making investments directly or indirectly (except for temporary funding needs of not more than 30 days, not more than 4 occasions per year, and not more than 10% of investable funds).
Must provide monthly NAV to investors.

explanation.text: The Logic: Regulations 16 (Cat I) and 17 (Cat II) prohibit Cat I/II AIFs from leveraging or borrowing for investment. Temporary funding is permitted only when it is not more than 30 days, on not more than 4 occasions per year, and not more than 10% of investable funds. The Trap: 2x NAV leverage is not the Cat I/II rule. 'Only listed equity' is false. Monthly NAV is not the Cat I/II rule. Note: The workbook supports the no-leverage rule and the temporary funding exception with the three thresholds (30 days, 4 occasions per year, 10% of investable funds). The threshold base is investable funds (not corpus), and unsupported Cat III and bridge-loan commentary has been removed.
